title: P1b fix round 1: review packet honours the complexity-7 security bump and the fail-closed review reasons (diff_unavailable, security_paths_empty), one bounding pass for the diff without nested truncation, and render() requires a packet for review, spec-review and scout instead of a kwarg fallback (review T-0467)
spec:
Fix round for T-0462 (P1b) on its branch task/T-0462 at 250486c, addressing security review T-0467 (three findings). Base goal/T-0445.
1. spawn.review_packet security section (spawn.py around 433): the section is included when any of these hold: a scope path matches [review].security_paths; the semantic trigger fires; the review task's complexity >= the checklist threshold daemon uses (SECURITY_CHECKLIST_COMPLEXITY, 7; import the constant or read it from one shared place so the two cannot drift); the reviewed task's pipeline.review_reason is one of security_paths, diff_unavailable, security_paths_empty (fail closed: an unavailable diff or an empty security_paths list always yields the section with the checklist pointer and a line naming the reason). review_packet takes the review task (for complexity and review_reason) as well as the reviewed task. Test: test_review_packet_security_section_on_complexity_bump_and_fail_closed_reasons (three cases: complexity 7 with no glob match; review_reason diff_unavailable; security_paths empty; each yields the section; complexity 4 with no trigger yields none).
2. Bounding (around 452): a single pass. Compute the budget left for the diff from the lengths of the other sections first (cap total about 8000 chars as today), call bounded_diff once with that budget, and never re-wrap the result with bounded_text; acceptance and gate stay untrimmed. Test: test_review_packet_single_bounding_pass_no_nested_truncation (large acceptance, scope and gate plus a 30k-char diff: the packet is under the cap, contains exactly one "expand with:" hint, and the hint is intact).
3. render() (around 87): remove the ad-hoc kwarg fallback that builds a packet from raw kwargs for review, spec-review and scout; when packet is missing for those roles render raises ValueError naming the role (so no unbounded, security-unaware prompt can be produced). Update the three legacy tests (test_templates_fill, test_scout_prompt_names_base, test_render_does_not_rebound_diff) to pass a packet built by the P1b packet builders; add test_render_requires_packet_for_review_spec_review_scout.
Keep every T-0462 test and all existing tests green; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; commit on task/T-0462's branch with the task id including every named test; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: review_packet includes the security section for complexity >= 7 and for review_reason diff_unavailable or security_paths_empty; the diff is bounded exactly once; render raises without a packet for review, spec-review and scout
all T-0462 tests and existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
